subject: general
question: Which famous Indian dancer was given the title of Asthana Narthaki ("Resident Dancer") by the Tirumala Tirupathi Devasthanam temple, India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yamini Krishnamurthy.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Yamini Krishnamurthy was given the title of Asthana Narthaki by the Tirumala Tirupathi Devasthanam temple in 1980.**
 
• She is a renowned Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi dancer who has performed on stages all around the world.</li
